summary: All In FutureTech Alliance filed an 8-K disclosing May 22 and September 2, 2026 letters from counsel for Primo Vital Limited, a stockholder and subsidiary of Ourgame International Holdings, a Cayman entity in official liquidation since March 3, 2026. The letters claim Jingsheng (Jason) Lu was removed as Primo director on May 19, 2026, lacked authority since March 3, and that the company's beneficial ownership disclosure covering 11,986,523 shares, roughly 31.3% of common stock, in its 2025 Form 10-K and special meeting proxy was inaccurate. The company takes no position, citing reliance on the December 11, 2024 Schedule 13D/A. Watch for 13D amendments, proxy contest risk, or voting-control litigation affecting the stake.
